# Lumina — published site

This repository holds **only the built output** of Lumina, published to
GitHub Pages. It is public because Pages on the Free plan cannot serve from
a private repository; the compiled bundle is what a browser downloads anyway.

**The source is private** and lives in `duckthetiler-max/lumina`. Do not edit
anything here by hand — it is overwritten on every publish. Publish with
`npm run publish:pages` from the source repo.

Live: https://duckthetiler-max.github.io/lumina-app/
